metadata.name: Google Translate
metadata.author: kanaru313
metadata.description: Translates lyrics line by line using Google Translate. Works out of the box with no API key required, or with your own Google Cloud Translation API key.

serviceHost.title: Google Translate service
serviceHost.subtitle: Domain used for free requests (when no API key is specified)

apiKeys.title: Google Cloud Translation API keys (optional)
apiKeys.subtitle: Leave empty to use Google Translate for free. Provide Cloud Translation API v2 keys if you have a Google Cloud account

keepSymbols.title: Preserve empty and symbol lines
keepSymbols.subtitle: Lines without words (♪, ..., x2) are kept as-is and not sent to Google Translate
